answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns sits in a time-locked vault for 30 epochs, and any slashing evidence against it during that window burns the balance. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fresh agents must fund and operate all of them through the whole lock, so a canyon opens between upfront cost and payout. When a tide of linked accounts is caught grading each other, the locked rewards of the entire cluster are forfeited, making mass identities a net loss.
